authority_hierarchy: LEVEL 1: Official Government source / official dataset
LEVEL 2: Official government scheme guideline / notification

sources.name: SIH 2026 LAND2BIZ problem brief (core loan calculator)
sources.coverage: LAND2BIZ baseline: 10% margin / 90% loan; Micro <= Rs 1.4L @6.5% 3y + 3m moratorium cap Rs 1.25L; Term <= Rs 50L @8% 7y + 6m moratorium cap Rs 45L
sources.authority_level: LEVEL 2 (project rule; umbrella NBCFDC FAQ differs: 7%/8% slabs)
limitations: Hackathon simplification of NBCFDC umbrella rules; final sanction = State Channelizing Agency / bank

sources.name: NBCFDC Frequently Asked Questions
sources.organization: National Backward Classes Finance & Development Corporation, Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment
sources.coverage: Individual loan: 85% of project cost up to Rs 15L; up to Rs 1.25L @7% 4y; above Rs 1.25L @8% 7y; Group loan: 90% up to Rs 15L/group, Rs 1.25L/beneficiary @6% 3y; moratorium 1 quarter
limitations: OBC target group + Rs 3L family income cap; SIH brief uses simplified 6.5%/8% — disclose divergence

sources.name: Census of India 2011 + Tamil Nadu district portal
sources.organization: Office of the Registrar General & Census Commissioner, India / Government of Tamil Nadu
sources.coverage: Tamil Nadu state total 7,21,47,030 (2011); district area/population/density; decadal growth 15.6% (2001-2011)
limitations: HISTORICAL baseline only — never live footfall; post-2019 new-district figures are administrative splits, not fresh census counts; growth-adjusted estimate MUST be ESTIMATED

sources.name: National ODOP Product List V32
sources.organization: Government of India (One District One Product)
sources.coverage: Tamil Nadu rows 961-1015: primary/secondary product + sector per district
limitations: Product list, not demand/profitability proof; ODOP alone never guarantees demand

retrieval.method: PDF fetched and read 2026-09-10 (Tamil Nadu pages 32-34)

sources.name: OpenStreetMap + Overpass API (live mapped objects)
sources.coverage: Mapped nodes/ways/relations within radius: roads, water, schools, health, banks, retail, cold-chain-mapped, dairy, fuel/charging
limitations: MAPPED OBJECTS ONLY — never total ground truth; mapped=0 does NOT mean none exist; coverage varies by village

sources.name: Nominatim reverse-geocode / geocoding
limitations: Location normalization only — never proof of business existence

sources.name: PM Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises (PMFME)
sources.coverage: Individual micro units: 35% credit-linked capital subsidy, cap Rs 10L/unit, min 10% beneficiary share, back-ended via bank; new individual units only via SHG/FPO/Co-op ODOP pathway
limitations: Only eligible food-processing activity; individual pathway restricted; subsidy released after operation, not upfront cash

retrieval.method: pmfme.org scheme pages fetched and read 2026-09-10 (official portal timed out; re-verify on pmfme.mofpi.gov.in)

sources.name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
sources.coverage: Margin-money matrix: general-urban 15%, general-rural 25%, special-urban 25%, special-rural 35%; caps Rs 50L manufacturing / Rs 20L service; own share general 10% / special 5%; TDR 3y lock-in + physical verification + Udyam before adjustment
limitations: Old Rs 25L/10L caps seen online are outdated; land cost excluded; EDP training + one-per-family rules apply

retrieval.method: MSMEGyan summary of MoMSME O.M. fetched 2026-09-10; re-verify on KVIC portal

sources.name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)
sources.coverage: Shishu <= Rs 50k; Kishore Rs 50k-5L; Tarun Rs 5-10L; Tarun Plus Rs 10-20L (only after successful Tarun repayment, w.e.f. 24.10.2024); collateral-free via MLIs + CGFMU
limitations: Slabs/rules may change — every rule carries effective_from + last_verified

sources.name: Stand-Up India (SUPI)
sources.coverage: Composite loan Rs 10L-1Cr, SC/ST and/or women, greenfield, 51% holding; margin up to 15% (min 10% borrower); CGFSIL cover; 7y tenure
limitations: Never assume eligibility from business type alone; portal timed out 2026-09-10 — re-verify on standupmitra.in

sources.name: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF)
sources.coverage: Rs 1L-cr facility; 3% subvention on first Rs 2Cr up to 7y; CGTMSE cover; moratorium 6m-2y; tenure up to 14y; post-harvest + community assets incl. cold chain
sources.data_period: launched 09.08.2020; disbursement window to 2025-26, subvention to 2032-33
limitations: Loan, not grant; only applicable AIF categories; stackable with PMFME on different cost heads

retrieval.method: agri.bot AIF reference fetched 2026-09-10; re-verify on agriinfra.dac.gov.in

sources.name: Agri-Clinics and Agri-Business Centres (ACABC)
sources.organization: DA&FW via MANAGE Hyderabad; NABARD refinance
sources.coverage: Agri graduates/diploma: 45-day residential training + 2y handholding; ceiling Rs 20L individual (Rs 25L exceptional) / Rs 1Cr group-of-5; back-ended composite subsidy 36% general, 44% women/SC/ST/NE/hilly
limitations: NEVER quote in DPR without checking current circular — slab varies by notification

retrieval.method: agri.bot ACABC + Federal Bank ACABC pages fetched and read 2026-09-10

sources.name: National Industrial Classification 2008
sources.coverage: 5-digit activity classes incl. 52101 refrigerated warehousing, 5210 warehousing, food-processing classes
limitations: Ambiguous mappings (e.g. EV charging) MUST be NEEDS_VERIFICATION, never invented

sources.name: Udyam Registration portal
sources.coverage: Registration process, enterprise classification, Aadhaar/PAN/NIC requirements
limitations: LAND2BIZ generates ASSISTANCE only — never claim registration completed; portal timed out 2026-09-10

sources.name: myScheme discovery portal
limitations: Discovery info is NOT an eligibility guarantee; every scheme needs versioned rule record
